# Schemas
{: .no_toc}

Schemas define the type-specific fields of BrainSTEM's modular records. When you pick a type in a form (a procedure type, a data acquisition type, a consumable type, a coordinate system) the form shows the fields of that type's schema, and the values are validated against it. Every schema is versioned and published, so exports can cite the exact version a record was validated against.

## Subjects and in-vivo procedures

What is done to a subject and what is logged about it over time.

| Schema family | Types | Where it is used |
|:--------------|:------|:-----------------|
| [Procedure types](/datamodel/schemas/procedure/) | 46 | Procedure, Procedure template |
| [Procedure stage types](/datamodel/schemas/specimenprocedurestage/) | 2 | Procedure and specimen procedure stages |
| [Procedure log types](/datamodel/schemas/procedurelog/) | 3 | Procedure log |
| [Subject log types](/datamodel/schemas/subjectlog/) | 16 | Subject log |

| [Manipulation types](/datamodel/schemas/manipulation/) | 18 | Manipulation, Manipulation template |
| [Coordinate systems](/datamodel/schemas/coordinates/) | 22 | Equipment, Experimental interface, Experimental interface template, Procedure, Procedure template |

## Materials

| [Consumable types](/datamodel/schemas/consumable/) | 22 | Consumable, Consumable approval |
| [Consumable stock types](/datamodel/schemas/consumablestock/) | 21 | Consumable stock |
| [Material usage types](/datamodel/schemas/materialusage/) | 82 | Material usage, Material usage template |

## Equipment and devices

The shared catalog of hardware devices and the equipment installed in a lab's setups.

| Schema family | Types | Where it is used |

| [Hardware device types](/datamodel/schemas/hardwaredevice/) | 54 | Hardware device, Hardware device approval |

## Structured fields and relations

A few records also have structured fields (additional fields, repository links, external identifiers, specifications) whose rows follow a schema that does not depend on a type. They are described on the page of the record: [Behavioral paradigm](/datamodel/taxonomies/behavioralparadigm/#structured-fields), [Data storage](/datamodel/personal_attributes/datastorage/#structured-fields), [Project](/datamodel/stem/project/#structured-fields), [Session](/datamodel/stem/session/#structured-fields), [Setup](/datamodel/personal_attributes/setup/#structured-fields), [Species](/datamodel/taxonomies/species/#structured-fields), [Strain](/datamodel/taxonomies/strain/#structured-fields), [Subject](/datamodel/stem/subject/#structured-fields).

The [Relations](/datamodel/schemas/relations/) page lists which types can be combined: which interface types a data acquisition type accepts, which coordinate systems a procedure type offers, and which catalog types a stock type draws from.
